# Newera Property Management

> Licensed Texas property management company for single-family homes and multifamily rentals in San Antonio and Houston. Founded and run by real estate investors. Management fee: 8% of monthly rent, with portfolio discounts down to 6%. No markup on vendor invoices.

## What we do
- Marketing, leasing and tenant screening (criteria published at https://newerapm.com/qualification-criteria/)
- Online rent collection and monthly owner reporting; owner payouts on a monthly schedule, typically by the 10th once rent has been collected and cleared
- Maintenance and vendor management, prioritized by urgency: emergencies typically dispatched within the hour, urgent items the same day, routine items within a few business days
- 24/7 emergency line answered by a real person, not a call center
- Property inspections every 6 months, documented with photos in the owner portal
- Brokerage: buyer and seller representation

## Who we work with
Owners and investors with single-family and multifamily rentals.

## Where we work
San Antonio, Houston, and their surrounding metropolitan areas.

## Pricing
- Management fee: 8% of monthly rent
- Portfolio discounts: down to as little as 6% for owners with multiple properties
- Leasing and renewal fees: quoted during a free consultation, based on the property
- Any other fees are spelled out in writing before the owner signs
- No markup on vendor invoices. No administration fees. No hidden charges.
- Owners keep a maintenance reserve; repairs under $500 are typically paid from it and the reserve is replenished from rent. Larger repairs are reviewed with the owner before work begins

## Hours
Office: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Central.
Emergency maintenance: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
